purpose: IVIMFitSlicer is a 3D Slicer extension that provides advanced Intravoxel Incoherent Motion (IVIM) diffusion-weighted MRI analysis, supporting voxel-wise parametric mapping and ROI-based statistical modeling across mono-exponential, bi-exponential, tri-exponential, and Bayesian fitting algorithms.
summary: IVIMFitSlicer is a well-structured, robust, and fully documented 3D Slicer extension for IVIM diffusion MRI analysis. It includes multi-model fitting algorithms, hybrid parametric mapping, DICOM b-value extraction, sample data registration, and a comprehensive self-test suite. All checks across safety, environment, packaging, license, soundness, and utility are fully satisfied. 🟢 Recommend merge.

safety.rationale: Inspected all Python code and CMake files; no unauthorized data transmission, telemetry, hardcoded secrets, unsafe execution, or malicious behavior found.

environment.rationale: Inspected module code and setup; dependencies are loaded lazily inside methods via pip_install or standard imports without altering global environment state, pins, or bundled packages.

packaging.rationale: Inspected CMakeLists.txt and IVIMFitSlicer/CMakeLists.txt; properly builds and packages scripted Python modules, resources, and tests in accordance with Slicer extension standards.

license.rationale: Inspected LICENSE file in the repository root; standard permissive MIT License with clear copyright attribution (2025 Atakan Isik).

soundness.rationale: Inspected IVIMFitSlicer.py and test_IVIMFitSlicer_roundtrip.py; clean module structure, robust error handling, proper observer cleanup mixin, and comprehensive round-trip tests covering fitting algorithms and data validators.

utility.rationale: Inspected README.md, sample data registration, and test suite; comprehensive documentation, sample data source, and rigorous verification suite included.

not_checked: Execution of unit tests against a running 3D Slicer instance (automated testing framework verified code structure and self-test suite).
